# Offline synthetic audit scope

Audit all four numbered dossiers. Every organization, price, policy, metric and
observation below is invented for this test. Treat each dossier as a separate
scenario. Owner-approved records are comparison evidence within that scenario,
not independently verified live behavior. The supplied documents are complete
only where explicitly stated. Preserve market, billing, audience and date scope.

Review content quality, SEO, AIO, AEO, GEO and portfolio where evidence permits.
No live account, engine output, rankings, keyword volume or index evidence exists.
Do not infer missing observations are zero. Recommend actions only; do not modify
targets, publish content, access accounts, fetch URLs or install anything.

Account for every dossier and discuss clean/uncertain cases as well as findings.
Use exact source locators, preserve qualifying facts, consolidate one issue across
dimension labels, and keep observation separate from interpretation. Read access
does not mean the content is fully audited. Outputs go outside this directory.
